And now the seniors for the Eau Claire Emmanuel Lutheran Lancers. Senior utility player number four, Levi Whitorpe. The Eau Claire Emmanuel Lutheran Lancers are coached by Joe Lau. And now here are the seniors for the Eau Claire Memorial Old Ames baseball team. Senior number six, Charlie Brand. Senior number nine, Chase Braedle. Senior number seven, Zach Kateror. Senior number five, Daelin Corn. Senior number four, Alex Krijewski. Senior number 11, Jack Piper. Senior number three, Carson Suckup. Senior number 20, Chase Toman. Senior number 17, Mitchell Voller. And senior number 10, Jonah Wiggins. The old apes are coached by Dan Rail. And now here are the 20/20 seniors for Eau Claire Regis Rambler's baseball. A senior infielder and pitcher number 18, Mason Power. A senior first baseman number 45, Robbie Burhop. A senior outfielders number 16, Joe Edge. A senior designated hitter, pitcher and first baseman. Number eight, Matt Klink. A senior outfielder and designated hitter number 29, Vinnie Ricardi. A senior shortstop and pitcher number 19, Luke Rooney. A senior catcher number nine, Tristan Root. The Eau Claire Regis Ramblers are coached by Andy Deese.
